title: Issues Old & New, but I still LOVE you!
review_text:
I wanted a Bellabeat for years before I could afford one. I have an old Lilac, purchased used, and if it ever kicks the bucket, or they stop supporting it, it will probably be several more years before I can afford to get one of the new devices, second-hand. Hoping it’ll hang on for a few more years at least.

Anyway, some of my gripes are about the updated app (like LOTS of other reviews), but something I’ve wished since I got my Lilac is the option to record sleep beginning before 9 p.m. In the winter, especially, I fall into bed at 7:30 some evenings. I understand if the device itself is hard-wired, but the app at least, should allow for manual correction to a time earlier than 9 p.m.

My new gripes are in a similar vein to many others already published here. I’m not a fan of the wellness score. I wouldn’t mind it so much if it were possible in the app settings to choose what data to center when opening up the app and right after a sync. Personally, I’m most interested in my sleep stats, so it seems like I should have the option for the detailed sleep info screen to pop up after a sync. 

It would be great to have this kind of control on the home screen too. I would probably choose to view sleep, meditation and activity/steps and hide the wellness score as well as water intake, since I never intend to use this app for tracking that.

Also, whose idea was it to have yesterday’s wellness score be the first thing you see after a sync? To me, that makes ZERO sense. If I’m syncing info on a Wednesday (which includes sleep from Tuesday to Wednesday, (why on earth would I expect the thing I see as soon as the sync is over to be a score including sleep stats from Monday night? It’s not just after morning syncs either. Every sync is followed by a display of “yesterday’s” stats. So even syncing on a Wednesday evening is going to conclude with a reminder about Tuesday’s wellness score, even if you’ve already synced a time or two throughout the day.

I had a hysterectomy last year, and from the complainants in other reviews, it sounds like the frustrations of dealing with that functionality on here is one more reason in the growing list to be grateful for that.

I’m giving 4 stars, because honestly your product (your stylish fitness jewelry) is really lovely and quite amazing in its functionality. Time to rectify some of the issues with the app, both old and new.

Thanks
~Juliet

As a mail carrier who walks 9 hours a day it is mega important to be prepared.  Since the change in design, I cannot trust the app to even be keeping track at all.  Currently it says it has no info for this month and doesn’t show last month in a manner I even understand.  I am very disappointed in the recent changes and am feeling stressed about having to find and adjust to another app.  I don’t understand messing with something that is working- we need accuracy and simplicity over whatever you are going for here.

title: Not useful for tracking period cycle
review_text:
The only thing I use this app for is to track my period, and it used to be effective for that, but now that feature is garbage. Even their latest update to fix whatever bug there was seems to have made it worse. I tried to enter the dates for my latest period and got a “period cannot start during another cycle” error message, though there was no overlap that I could see. I also don’t see why they would impose strict parameters when many women have irregular periods or bleeding/spotting that they would still like to track for health reasons. 

I gave it two stars instead of one bc I haven’t really used the other features of the app, which might redeem it. 

Oh, also, the last time I tried to use my leaf, it was pretty terrible at accurately measuring exercise and steps and transmitting them to my app.

title: Did you guys forget you have other products
review_text: My Android phone broke where I had my original Bella beat leaf app. Your new app doesn’t give the option to reload app for this product on an iPhone. Please assist.

title: Most Recent Upadate
review_text: Most recent update has completely screwed up my cycle tracking! I’m using this for IVF cycles so I need it to be accurate and now I have to find something else. Considering switching to the Apple Watch even though I loved a nice looking fitness tracker. I’ve had this for 3 years, please fix it!

title: Has gone downhill
review_text:
I used to love my Bellabeat and the Bellabeat app.
Since the ‘Wellness score’ was added, the app hasn’t been as user friendly or as encouraging.  I don’t track my water intake (I drink plenty of water but don’t have time to enter each ounce) and I don’t enter my meditation minutes (I use a great meditation app - Insight Timer).  I don’t feel like logging my minutes in a separate app.
So the highest score I can get is an 80, if I hit my sleep and exercise goals.  I feel the app is more discouraging since they implemented this score.
Also, the period is now impossible to track.  I tried to enter the first day of my period today but it wants to tell me that my period started 3 days ago, not today.  And it won’t let me change it.  It also says my next period is in 53 days…. What???
The addition of the score and the change of the period feature make me want to switch to a Fitbit.  Don’t waste your energy or your money on Bellabeat.

title: I wish the app worked better
review_text:
I came here to talk about the app. It’s CLUNKY! They updated it and most of the features don’t even work. Also, the readiness score is kind of confusing… how the app describes the way it calculates your specific data is very vague which makes me think it’s not that accurate… I haven’t tried customer service yet but I’m considering it. Overall I think they could refine the current details of the app, it’s pretty intuitive but glitchy enough for me to want to write a review. 

I’ve had the Ivy bracelet for 2.5 months now.

title: Terrible for tracking
review_text: Wow, I’ve had this app and fitness tracker for years and been very pleased with functionality. The last few updates, however, have made it basically unusable for tracking monthly cycles. It literally will not let me enter the date I begin a period. Extremely disappointed. Like you hired some new young marketers and made the app ‘pretty’ but very less functionable!

title: Last update screwed everything up
review_text: I’ve had Bellabeat for years and now my Cycle tracking is all messed up and doesn’t show anything prior to December.

title: App Has Declined
review_text:
This app doesn’t work as well as it used to. They include mindfulness videos and audio files and they don’t automatically track in the system. This is something they’ve been planning to fix for months but it still doesn’t work. But I don’t understand why you would release a new tracker (Ivy) that you’ve been testing over a year without having this working already.

And most recently the period tracker is now recording the wrong dates after you save them.

title: Infuriating app or device?
review_text:
I’ve had my Leaf since March of 2021. I wanted a simple, easy to use step counter to keep me mindful about movement as I was trying to pull myself out of a pandemic funk quite literally one step at a time. I love that I can clip it on my bra strap and essentially forget about it, but sync and check step progress as needed. I don’t like to wear a watch, or carry my phone with me all the time. 

The Leaf seemed to do the trick until August, when it stopped syncing. I replaced the battery but the battery wasn’t the problem. After many weeks of back and forth troubleshooting emails with Bellabeat, I ended up with a new device. Customer service was helpful, but it took forever- they should put everything in our email  exchanges in a “troubleshooting” section within the app or online.   In case it’s helpful for others, their advice was to very gently raise the two little prongs under the battery, and then tighten the screws for the cover the very least amount possible so as not to press the two little prongs down again.  This worked intermittently, but was an unacceptable long term solution to have to open the device to reset it every time I wanted to use it (which was daily). As I said, they replaced my device. 

My new Leaf seemed to be working fine until sometime after the app was updated.  Shortly before Thanksgiving, my device would sync, but sometimes show no new data after the sync. I could not for the life of me figure out the rhyme or reason as to when this would happen.  I tried looking for patterns (in the morning, if I open the app but it still shows yesterday’s date? Yes, but also in the middle of the day when I’ve already used the app!)  Again I emailed customer service to explain the problem.  Their answer wasn’t super helpful, and suggested syncing twice a day at minimum. Once in the morning and again in the evening. It seems like it’s more likely to be accurate if I close the app each morning and open it before I sync, but that doesn’t always work either (like today, and many other days).  

After the morning sync, it sometimes doesn’t show step data for right away in the morning, but will after the next sync. Sometimes it does for the early morning, but then not for mid morning, or the afternoon, or late afternoon and evening. I just can’t figure out when it’s going to give data and when it’s not! To clarify, the problem with the the first device was that it wouldn’t sync. This second Leaf syncs no problem, just no updated steps after. 

I don’t know if it’s the device or the app, but one or both of them is functioning inconsistently.  Maybe I’ve been unlucky and it’s a second faulty device.  Is the quality control of the device an issue? Something in the app that’s glitchy? Sometimes it will pop up to give me yesterday’s summary in the middle of the day or at night. Is that when the data doesn’t update? Sometimes yes, other times no. I have no idea. I can’t find a clear pattern.  

When my Leaf and the app work properly I love everything about this little device. However, when it doesn’t load any data after a sync the rage I feel toward my Leaf is irrational and certainly negatively contributing to my overall health goals! (I try to reframe as giving me time to practice deep breathing! Lol) 

I’m at the point of looking to a different brand for a small bra strap step counter.  This also annoys me because of all the time I’ve invested in this device. I’m also sending this post as an email to customer service. Maybe they’ll have some additional ideas, or I’ll get a reply here, and can figure out how to have the simple, elegantly functioning device I want to love work for me again.

title: Gone
review_text: The app just disappeared from my phone when I updated it 2 weeks ago

title: Steps not tracking
review_text: I’m having issues with my Leaf not counting steps after this latest update. At first I thought maybe it was the battery because the app had it at 48%, so I changed it and it worked for a day and is now back to not counting steps.  I’ve unpaired and repaired, closed the app out, changed the battery AGAIN, and again it worked for a day, then stopped counting steps.  This is the main feature I use on here, so it’s frustrating that it’s not working.

title: Wouldn’t advise a download!
review_text: Unfortunately it’s not made clear anywhere that you need to purchase the brand’s fitness tracker for this app to be most functional and it doesn’t read my health data from my apple or my fitness tracker so it’s kind of pointless. They also don’t have any accurate or clear information on how to cancel an app-made subscription before the free trial ends so they force you into paying and cancelling after the fact. Disappointed I downloaded it in the first place.

title: Sleep Tracking
review_text: I have been using this for a week now. The preview of my sleep shows periods of light sleep, deep sleep, and wake but when I look at the actual sleep screen it shows everything as light sleep. Not sure what’s wrong but will be returning the Ivy if this does not get resolved.

title: Menstrual tracking is an afterthought now?
review_text: I am deeply disappointed in the recent update to the user interface that has hidden the menstrual cycle information and made it largely inaccessible and more difficult to use. The Leaf and the app were originally advertised as the only tracker on the market to track your menstrual cycle, and while I understand the focus can be shifted over time, I am SO upset with this latest UI update. It no longer shows you where you are on your cycle on the main page, and menstrual information is completely hidden unless you click around and make a point to find it. For those of us who have used this app as a main form of tracking our cycles, this is a total slap in the face.

title: Where’s the fertility tracker?
review_text: I have been using the leaf for years and have loved it. This time when I updated my app, I cannot find the fertility tracker. I am disappointed if this is no longer a feature for the leaf. I would hate to have to go back to tracking my cycles in my paper planner.

title: The new dashboard is awful
review_text: I updated to the new version and the interface is terrible. It’s hard to read. I just want to see my stats, the Wellness score is useless to me. And your marketing totally ignores and in fact insults my demographic- I’m 62, post menopausal, can’t relate to your branding and vibe. Sorry.

title: New upgrade is huge disappointment
review_text:
I have been using my Bellabeat Time to keep track of my steps. I love having an analog watch. It looks beautiful.

Ever since Bellabeat upgraded their app to a new design, I have been unable to sync my Time. I have been trying for a week. There is really no support to reach out to to help remedy this situation.I think this upgrade is nothing but a money grab. Extremely disappointing.

title: the “upgrade” no longer shows the information I want
review_text: The new app interface no longer shows the information I want and it takes clicking through several screens to get there. There is no way to avoid the unhelpful “wellness score” and they’ve removed the option to actually contact customer service. What used to be a fun fitness tracker now seems to be a means to encourage you to buy their ever growing suite of smart trackers.

title: App: info stored but not displayed correctly
review_text:
This is a review for the app, not my Time watch. I really like my watch. 

I give the app 3 stars because I can see it has my data entries saved, and with some work I can look back and find it, but it is the display that is often inaccurate. 

1, After I sync my Time, I have to close out of the app and reopen it to see an accurate display on the dashboard area day-of. 
2, when going back to look at previous days, the dashboard display is inaccurate. Most of the time I can click into the topic and actually see my data, but it messes with the display and again will need to close out the app and re-open if I want to see accurate display of the current day. 

I have hope these will get fixed! It’s not stopping me from using my Time, it’s just little extra things that are small annoyances 😅

title: Terrible app update
review_text:
I have been a Bellabeat customer for over 6 years and have had 3 devices. I love the jewelery look still— that’s what drew me in. I really hate the new app update. 
The dashboard can’t be customized any more. It’s hard to get the daily numbers now that I want to look at side by side. 
And it gives me a bad wellness score because I don’t want to track all the things they have in there now. 
This is not a good update. 
I don’t even want to sync to look at my numbers any more.

title: New version is not awesome
review_text:
There used to be a screen that would easily display how many steps you had taken, etc. Now it takes you to this overall score, and you have to dig to find out how many’s yes you’ve taken. Those still don’t display on the front screen. Nor does the other criteria used for tracking.
Each one requires you to drill down. That front screen is clunky and awkward. This new version has definitely taken a step backward. Please fix.

title: App update
review_text: I do not like the update of this app.  I prefer to have a front page with edited summarized information.   I don’t like and will struggle to use this format.

title: New App Errors
review_text: The new design will take some getting used to - I like it though. Major issue with it: “today’s” data is all for yesterday! Makes it pretty useless as an at-a-glance dashboard. I hope they fix it quick.

title: The app changed
review_text: The app use to be simple and you could put in what you wanted and leave out what you wanted. Now it has a wellness score and you have to put everything in. I don’t like the new changes. The leaf it’s self is still great.

title: 5 years and going strong!
review_text: I've had my leaf for about 5 or 6 years now and I'm still loving it. There have been a few hiccups with the app here and there, but they always work themselves out. The fact that I don't have to charge it and change the battery every 6 months is a huge plus! The sleep tracking could be better, but for a fitness tracker, I love how simple it is. The new update has some serious wrinkles to iron out...every time I enter data, I have to restart the app to make my wellness score reflect appropriately. Not a big deal, just annoying and I'm sure it will get updated soon! Can't wait to see the reviews on the new device and potentially upgrade!

title: The product doesn’t last
review_text: The product will one day just up and stop working no longer syncing to the app or pairing to the Bellabeat. Support is awful you can only contact them by email and have to wait 48 hours for a response with the same answers as you find on the website. Still after a week no solution.

title: Used to love
review_text: I liked this app a lot. It Used to work great when I had my iPhone 8plus. Now that I have a new iphone 12pro, I can’t edit my sleep. It keeps freezing on me.

title: Would be great if it actually worked
review_text: I started with the original Leaf years ago and initially loved it. The first phone upgrade resulted in the app being unable to pair with the Leaf. I bought a Leaf Urban thinking I just needed a newer version to pair with the new phone, but no dice. I currently have an iPhone 11, and cannot pair the leaf, Eos, or Orabelle to sync them. So disappointing, and customer service is zero help. You can find tons of searches from other users having this issue online with no resolution. Ultimately you just end up with fancy jewelry that does not function and an app to help you track your cycles.

title: It’s nice
review_text:
I’ve had my Leaf for a month now, so I feel I’ve given it a good trial. It’s pretty, I wear it as a necklace, and it tracks my steps and sleep. Oftentimes I go without my phone so I like that it’s still counting. I would appreciate a bigger focus on sleep. More pages of sleep data, more viewing options for comparisons. Also, more exploration around poor sleep data: the app counts my restless nights as sleep and so “reduces” my stress susceptibility graph thing. 

One more practical thing: the leaf comes off of the chain fairly easily. I’ve noticed at least five times in the short time I’ve had it. I regularly sleep on my stomach, and in the night I have gotten up and it falls to the floor! So, something for the design team: as a necklace, make it less likely to fall off!

title: Last update broke the mediation part
review_text: Since the last update, it is not possible to choose one of the Recents to log meditation. One has to now search through a long list to find the needed meditation.

title: Bellabeat Leaf
review_text:
I have had NOTHING but issues with my Bellabeat Leaf product since I bought it. The original one NEVER worked properly and finally Bellabeat agreed with me and replaced it free of charge. The second Leaf worked pretty much fine and is now giving me the same issues as the first Leaf. Customer Service tries to help but my Leaf will Sync at times and not at other times. “Billie’s” suggestion was to “wait a couple days and see if it will sync with the new app.”  This isn’t customer service.  I have not been able to track my activity or sleep in 3 days and that’s why I bought this product!!! I’m totally frustrated and would NEVER EVER recommend a Bellabeat product to anyone. You’ll never receive satisfactory “customer service.”
Linda Showers

title: Beautiful device but be prepared to remove the battery to troubleshoot regularly
review_text: I bought the Leaf Urban in June after eyeing it for months. I wanted a fitness tracker but didn’t like the ugly watches of some other brands.  The Leaf seemed like it fit my needs perfectly. Loved it for two months, but then it stopped tracking, wouldn’t sync with my phone. I was told to remove the battery, delete the app, wait a minute, replace the battery, replace the app. That worked for a little while. Eventually the Leaf stopped working altogether (but long before the battery should gave died) and I put it aside, thinking my old phone was the problem. Brand new phone now, brand new Leaf battery, but the syncing issues persist. I find myself contacting tech support and going through that battery removal process about once a week.

title: Should’ve listened to other reviews
review_text:
The subscription portion of the app absolutely doesn’t function.  I signed up for my free trial via the app. It unlocked some items when I got the subscription but never asked me to fill out a questionnaire and never generated personalized j fo( ie nutrition) the entire time
I had the free trial.  Contacted Bellabeat for support.  It took more than two days to receive a response and the response simply asked if I had signed in with the correct email address despite the fact that I noted this in my initial query.  Tried signing in via the app on my phone, added the app on my iPad and signed in on the website.  Still nothing. And no response from customer service since letting them know that it was the correct email address.  All I can say is glad I found this out during the trial before I paid...theee are obviously some ongoing and serious issues with this app.  Probably would have been great had it worked.

title: Love everything about except for the bugs
review_text: This app crashes every time I try to use it.

title: Pretty but.......
review_text: I got the leaf because I wanted a tracker with a replaceable battery. I have had it less than a year. The app is very basic. I only use it for tracking walking. So much of the app options are premium. The sleep tracking never tracked correctly. It said I got less sleep than I did and it didn’t track more after middle of the night bathroom visits. But now it’s really frustrating. I recently had to change the battery for the first time. Since I changed it the leaf has problems tracking anything and doesn’t want to sync. I have taken the time to reseat the battery a couple of times. It will work again briefly, maybe a few hours, maybe a few days but then nothing. I think I’ll get a new Fitbit.

title: Not bad, but could be better.
review_text:
I hate wearing watches so I loved the necklace function. I wear this every day to track my sleep and steps. The steps are pretty good but the sleep tracker needs work. I work shift work and it only works at night, doesn’t track any of my day sleep. 
I love the recommendations for workouts and vitamins, but have been slacking and haven’t used any of them yet. It’s simple to track my hydration and periods as well.

title: Don’t start a free trial! Never able to log in, charges anyway
review_text:
Update: By reaching out to BellaBeat’s CEO on Twitter, I was able to get this resolved. It appears to be a bug in the version I and others downloaded, where we couldn’t log in. I was eventually refunded by going to the CEO. BellaBeat’s customer service response below is misrepresenting their capability to refund. While I’m grateful to finally get the refund, customers shouldn’t have to go to the lengths I did for a refund. The company should be more responsible with addressing bugs in its software—especially when it means new clients cannot access accounts or turn off billing. Until BellaBeat updates their app and assures new users that they will not be locked out and charged, I’d caution folks to not download this app.

1st review:

I registered an account with BellaBeat and signed up for the free week to try out the app/see if it would be a fit for me. Unfortunately, after setting it up, I was never able to log in to the app. I tried before the end of the week to reset my email address multiple times with nothing working. I was charged for the first month and emailed customer support, their log in advice didn’t work and they refused to refund me, first saying it wasn’t possible, then acknowledging its “company policy” to not refund any month. But they also acknowledged they couldn’t find my account in their system—BUT CHARGED ME ANYWAY AND DECIDED TO KEEP MY MONEY.

So, this now will be disputed through my bank. Apple should investigate the billing and account practices at this company as my experience is that this app is fraudulent—no real service behind it. Total waste of my money and time because of some glitch in their app/account management.

title: Subscription charged without notice
review_text:
I have had my leaf since 2017 and i loved it! I stopped using it and then last year or beginning of this year I started using it again and download the app. This month I was going through my credit card charges and found a $128 charge from BellaBeat... I sent an email to Customer service with no response yet. I am still waiting to hear from BellaBeat, I loved their app and their leaf, and it was free all the time and I wanna know where is this charge coming from.

title: TERRIBLE SCAM. DO NOT PURCHASE.
review_text:
I got the trial version and tried everything I could to cancel it before the trial ended. Well first of all you can’t cancel the trial. You have no such option in the app. I sent an email only to be told the trial was over that same day and I had been charged and could not be refunded. Not worth it if you ask me.
Also when I brought this up with customer service I was essentially told tough luck no refunds. Trust me- I have never ever written a review but this one right here deserves to be known far and wide DO NOT DO IT. it’s a rip off.

title: Please make Hydration goal adjustable!
review_text: The jewelry is gorgeous and I’m quite obsessed with the app, especially with the water intake.  There IS one change I’d want.  Activity, Sleep, and Mediation goals are adjustable, but Hydration goal is not.  Please change that.  It is fixed to 80 ounces a day.  According to my weight, it should be 60, but I can’t change that.   Otherwise, this had been so helpful with me taking better care of myself, especially with the stress monitor!  Love that!  I definitely would recommend to anybody who may be interested in it.

title: Great app mostly, but crashes CONSTANTLY
review_text: Love the device, it’s pretty accurate in tracking movements and sleep. App has great UI and a ton of features, but I Barry use most features because the app is constantly crashing. Most noticed when adding activities. When bugs get fixed, I know this app will become a go-to.

title: Misleading/Don't sign up for trial
review_text:
If I could I would report Bellabeat. This company is misleading. I get it. You want to find ways for people to come across your apps and use your apps so they can be influenced to buy your product. THAT DOES NOT MEAN you give people a long detailed quiz saying that you'll give them an ultimate weight loss nutrition plan then make them download/sign up to your app, for your app to make you take a basic quiz all over again and give a cookie cutter plan. Don't coerce me to sign up for a subscription that truly falls short on promises. 

Honestly, there are way too many apps that are honest, full of information and doesn't try to sell you on their product. 

I can see why people left reviews saying Bellabeat is a scam because Bellabeat sure isn't listed under honest either. 

This review isn't coming from a disgruntled customer who is fast to write bad reviews. This is coming from an honest working professional who praises things when they are good, but Bellabeat disappointed me. I would not recommend signing up for any trials. Keep your money and stay out of their drama. As a marketing professional I would never use their tactics.

title: Scam
review_text: I downloaded the app and it began a subscription service. When I saw the charge, I emailed the company. They refuse to refund me for the 6 month period, even though I am unable to use it. They have no real call number. This product is a scam!

title: Scam!!
review_text: This app is a scam! I canceled my membership after I realized the app really didn’t offer a diet plan. I was charged anyway and when I reached out to customer service I got a message saying someone would get back to me in 48 hours and no one ever did!! IM OUT $100, DO NOT SIGNUP FOR THIS

title: Disappointed
review_text: Terrible customer service!!! Tried to cancel and they charged my credit card anyway!!!! Beware!

title: Does not work after three months
review_text: I purchased this device in November and it worked for a couple of months. Now it will hardly ever sync and when it does, no activity has been captured. I should not have to constantly open up the device, turn off WiFi, turn Bluetooth off and on, bend up the pins to make the battery connect, as customer support directs me to do. It’s very pretty but I would not recommend. Will go back to Fitbit.

title: Decent hardware, disappointing app
review_text:
I’ve had a Leaf for about three weeks now and seem to be tracking steps accurately, but am continually disappointed with the app’s functionality. 

A) It doesn’t play well with iHealth so if you meditate or have active calories not tracked by BB, that info doesn’t transfer (i.e. no info *from* iHealth). 

B) It only transfers steps *to* iHealth so no impact on walking/running distance, flights climbed, etc. 

C) Amazingly, it doesn’t track activity from within its own app — like when you do a yoga class from the Workouts section (i.e. even though you’re wearing the device, every activity aside from steps needs to be manually logged). 

D) Sleep is consistently off — like, every night. It thinks sleep started hours after it did, that there were issues when there weren’t or vice versa, and wake has always been too early. After three weeks, I would hope this would calibrate. 

I didn’t expect it to be as smart as Fitbit, which guesses when you’re being active and asks if you’d like to add an activity, but not even registering activity logged within its own app, not transferring distance — c’mon. We can do better. 

It’s nice having a non-obvious fitness tracker. It’s just a bummer the tech doesn’t support it better.

title: The usability of this app is pretty bad...
review_text:
Many menus have no way of getting out of them, so my only option is to close the app and reopen. 

The “sync now” button doesn’t work? Or does it? I have no idea, and that’s super frustrating while I’m trying to set up the app.

I also wish I could set additional goals. And set notifications to remind me to log water, activity, etc.

Maybe with time the app will begin to feel more intuitive. Right now, as I try to get set up, it feels more challenging than it needs to be.

title: Most Beautiful Wellness Tracker
review_text:
I’ve been a Bellabeat user for 4 years and have multiple Leafs and the Time hybrid watch as well. They’re all beautiful in their own way and I love that they look more like beautiful jewelry instead of what they really are. 

I love that the company has a focus on women’s wellness as a whole as opposed to just fitness or weightloss. The app allows me to track all of the elements of my health that are important to me and everything is housed in one place. Activity, water intake, sleep, meditations, monthly cycles and more. Now that they’ve integrated workouts into the app as part of their Bellabeat Plus Club, it really is a one stop shop. The workouts vary in intensity and can easily be customized depending on your fitness level or how much time you have to spend on your workout for the day. 

The meditations are so wonderful and I find that I feel much less stressed and sleep better when I do them daily. 

Their customer service is also wonderful and are always helpful if I have a problem or question.

title: Love this tracker
review_text:
I’ve had my leaf since they first debuted five years ago. Even after all this time, when I had issues with the device, customer service was happy to help solve my problem, and ensure my tracker was working again. 

The only thing I don’t care for is that I can’t turn my screen off during the meditations. I like to fall asleep to some of them, but to do so, I have to leave my screen on, which drains my battery, so I’m waking up to a dead phone the mornings after I use it, which kind of discourages me. I’d love to be able to do that! 

An extra addition that would be awesome was if we could track our moods during pregnancy to more accurately track stress, and medications like antidepressants. 

Over all 4.95 out of five stars, but I rounded up because it’s an amazing tracker.

title: General review from a 50 year old former Fitbit user
review_text:
I received the Bella beat for Christmas. I work at a hospital and we are not allowed to wear wrist watches or hand/wrist jewelry to prevent infections between patients. I had a Fitbit One which was also a clip but after 2 years, it stopped working and they no longer make it! I was really excited to have another option with the Bellabeat. While Apple health tracks some things, I don’t always have my phone on me (especially since I use the AirPods) so it wasn’t an accurate measurement. Super happy to have this option. 

I have only used it for a day so keep this in mind ... 

Love that it operates on battery! This is by far the best feature, aside from the clip. 

Generally simple to use - appreciate the instructions that arrived in email. Had to watch an amateur you tube video on syncing - did not understand what they meant by tapping it to get it to sync! I actually wonder what that really does. I would include videos in the instructions to make them even clearer. 

Suggestions for newer versions 

* Steps tracking. I really miss this from my Fitbit and it is something that I would challenge myself to do. 

* Auto syncing with phone. While it isn’t difficult, it’s an extra step and hard for the app to accurately send out reminders to “get up and go” if it is manually synced. This is a major flaw in my opinion. 

* Option to remove or block reproductive health. I’m 50 and I’m not concerned about any of the features in this section. I can’t figure out how to remove it so it’s just extra clutter in the app for me. 

* Positive mantras or sayings sent to app would be great 

* Syncing with other food management apps like weight watchers - the big ones. 

Water proof?

title: I really wanted to love this but.......
review_text:
I read many reviews and even watched you tube videos before making this purchase. Decided to give it a try despite mostly negative reviews. I love the way my urban looks, but the app is very limited and could be so much better!!! 

First off, there are not any push notifications that alert you where you are in your goals in the day, you have to go into the app to see where you are at. If there is some setting that I can turn on to get these notifications, please developers, let me know!

Second, when manually putting in times for sleep and hydration, the app won’t allow you to put in the times that you want, there is a weird glitch that makes it so you bedtime/wake times are switched. For hydration, it defaults back to the current time. This is a common complaint. 

Third, I thought the stress sensitivity would be more comprehensive. Basically, if you have met all the goals that day, the app reports that you are resistant to stress. It doesn’t allow for input of personal history or making notes to reflect on how your day is actually going and how resistant you actually are.

Fourth, I agree with all the other reviews that the encouraging feedback for sleep/activity/hydration is absolutely ridiculous!! The feedback is so common sense and doesn’t give you any accurate or usable advice. When you sleep poorly, it tells you often that you are sleeping great, when you walk, the app tells you that you are getting oxygen. It is so silly, it’s as if they wrote the encouragement for kindergartners.  I think if the developers can’t improve this, they should just remove it all together because it’s inaccurate and borderline insulting to most consumer’s intelligence. 

Fifth, when worn as bracelet, the steps are very inaccurate, despite setting it to bracelet mode. It seems most accurate as necklace or clipped on your collar.

With all that said here are my positives:

I don’t mind manually syncing the data, I really like that I’m not wearing something on my body that is constantly connected to Bluetooth, unlike Fitbit or Apple watch. 

For me, sleep times have been mostly accurate when wearing it as a necklace or clip on, I haven’t had much of a problem like the other reviewers.

The urban is very beautiful. I do love the meditation guides, I feel like this where the developers focused most of their energy.

I got my leaf on sale for about 100$ as part of their Black Friday sale. If i had paid more, I’d be trying to return it. But I will keep trying to wear it and hopefully the app improves as the company grows. I really do want to see this company succeed because I believe that they have a good thing going, it just needs some work!

title: Has not improved over time
review_text:
I loved my leaf, and I was so excited for the app and using my stylish leaf. I would wear it every day, usually as a necklace or on my shirt. I would even wear it sleeping! 
But two years using the leaf and I have not seen any major improvements with the app at all. I feel like Bellabeat gave up on the Leaf and they are just constantly trying to create another “it” product instead of improving what they have and keeping their customer base happy. The biggest change I ever saw was the addition of water, and it seems like it’s only to promote their Spring water bottle. 
There are several areas that need serious improvement. 

Step Tracking
- There are several days I’ve seen where I’m riding in a car all day and some how that counts as thousands of steps when I haven’t moved an inch. There isn’t a way to modify the steps to say “no I wasn’t walking at this time” or anything.

Sleep Tracking 
- If you go to bed before 9pm good luck ever tracking your sleep! It’s as if Bellabeat thinks people don’t work nights or have early mornings. 
- There can be serious glitches where the tracker thinks I slept for 24 hours, even if there are steps registered during that time! It seems like a bug that should have been fixed a long time ago. 

Water 
- As mentioned below it’s mostly just for another product to buy from the company. There are no alarms or alerts to remind you to drink water. The app could at least give push notifications. 

Meditation 
- There are some really good points to the meditation, the guided meditations are very relaxing and are really the only thing that makes the app worth using 
- Why not have push notifications to remind people to meditate? Or have some special alarm set up for meditation? Such a simple change would have made this app and tracker to the next level. 

Stress level 
- This really could have been done way better than it is. There is no way to input your actual stress levels. It basically does a simple calculation based off of where you are in your cycle, how many steps you took, how much you slept, and if you meditated. It’s good for if you want a general overview of “oh I am near my period maybe I’m a bit stressed” but overall? It’s a horrible calculation with no direct input from the user. 

Period Tracking 
- Biggest problem it is it trans exclusive. Let’s face it not all women have uteruses and there is no option to opt out of the period Tracking. Some women don’t even have periods due to their medications or whatever. This should be a function that can be turned off easily. 

Lack of social contact or use with other apps 
- This is really where Bellabeat dropped the ball. There is no way to add friends, there are no blogs or articles to follow or read, there is nothing to make you spend time and stay on the app or keep on going back. 
- There is no way to connect to any other app (including my fitness pal) except for the Apple health app, which is pretty useless. 
- Apps cannot write onto the Bellabeat app, which is a pain if you are trying to combine two data sources 
- There is no way to keep track of calories burned from the activities. 

Overall, I feel like the developers basically gave up and thought it was “good enough” and never saw a reason to develop further and make this something with a growing community. It feels more like they were out to make a quick buck and didn’t have a long term plan in mind outside of the initial development. I loved this at first and used it religiously, but the more time went on and there weren’t any new features it felt like more of the same and just extra work. I felt like I was going into three different apps to track everything from just one workout. Sadly at this point unless I see a major overhaul of the app my little leaf will be sitting on a shelf and I will be buying a Fitbit to replace it. It may not be as stylish or cute, but it has the functionality you’ll miss using the leaf.

Thankfully, I have another app that I also log that data into separately, so I just re-entered it all into Leaf manually...but after a while it wouldn’t save any new manually entered cycle data. title: Could Use Improvement
review_text:
I'd like to start with what I like about the bellabeat app. 

1) Water tracking. I notoriously don't drink enough water, and this has helped a lot in making sure that I at least get close to consuming enough. ;)

2) Step tracking. It seems very accurate and helps me make sure I keep moving when I'm tempted to be sedentary. 

3) Period tracker. It's pretty. It's accurate. 

4) Meditation - The meditations are awesome. 

Now for the dislike:

1) It's not even close to being able to measure stress. No matter what day it is (and I've had my bellabeat on for a month now), the beat always says I'm stress resistant. I have an anxiety disorder, so I'm often stressed even when I've slept, etc. Something will need to be adjusted to make this more accurate. 

2) I'd like a period tracker that helps me to keep up with when I've had sex. For this reason, I'm still using Spot On because it's easier to look back on when I've been sexually active. 

3) Sleep tracking. It's pretty accurate. Probably as accurate as a device like this can be. However, it is difficult to adjust sleep in the app without messing up the recorded data and often I need to readjust the time. So if recording in the app could be improved, that'd be nice. 

Overall, I love my bellabeat. I think anyone who doesn't love it has unrealistic expectations. That said, a few tweaks to the app could make it better. Cheers!

title: Enjoying new Leaf & app but needs improvements

I’m enjoying my new Leaf Urban and the accompanying app, especially the sleep tracking (which seems accurate when device is clipped at waist). Step tracking seems accurate, meditations are nice/helpful, and I actually use and appreciate the hydration tracker more than expected.

However, I do wish the sleep tracker was more thorough (more info about sleep quality), and that it automatically tracked naps. I often sleep in multiple shorter stints due to the time constraints of my occupation, and long naps are crucial to getting my needed hours. As is, I have to manually log naps (easy to forget), and the app only tracks sleep quality of overnight sleeps, but naps can be half of my daily sleep! 

Additionally, and possibly more important, the period tracker really needs to be more robust. I find I’m reverting to a different, free app to track my cycle, because the Leaf app is really insufficient. I can’t retroactively log when my period starts (who honestly knows exactly when their period starts in their 40’s+, or with menstrual issues, or has a moment to log it when it happens?). Plus, there’s no detail whatsoever in period tracking (as others have described).

One other thing... Would it be possible in future Leaf releases to add a thermometer and maybe a temperature tracker to the hardware? It would be really helpful for anyone with health issues, and for women trying to conceive (especially with a more robust period tracker).

And, of course, I’m hoping at some point a waterproof option is developed for us swimmers.

title: Lifestyle options
review_text:
I received my LEAF Magnolia about a week ago and, while I love it, there are some definite kinks that need to be worked out. The first is sleep tracking: I work nights, so I don't generally get to bed until after 4am (sometimes much later). The LEAF is so stuck on the standard day/night cycle, though, that it inaccurately records my sleep, especially if I sync it before I go to bed. Further, when I wake up to use the restroom, it'll assume I'm up for the day and stop tracking sleep, despite my getting another three or four hours of it!
Several others have suggested improvements I would also like to see: water/beverage tracking, a greater variety of alert vibrations, more in-depth period tracking (symptoms like bloating, breast tenderness, mood, digestion, food cravings, etc.) and more apropos messages as they are utterly generic and unrelated to my personal performance. 
The leather bracelet band is nice and does stretch a bit with wear, but it was only *just* big enough to fit my wrist which is the only place I can wear it due to physical limitations. I know its fit will improve as I do, but I'm about average size for a woman my age and this fit issue may be discouraging for bigger women who want to use it. 
Thank you for your continued efforts to make the LEAF the perfect tracker. I look forward to seeing its progress.

review_text:
I really do like my leaf. I get complements on it often and i love how versatile it is. The steps are fairly accurate depending on how you wear it. The necklace tends to swing more if you lean or move a lot, which will count extra steps, but that is to be expected. 
My biggest gripe is with the sleep tracker, which was the main reason i bought the leaf. I find that if i set it down while i shower at night, it tracks extra sleep time, then thinks I'm awake when i put it back on for bed, and then continues tracking sleep, which means i need to adjust the sleep time. The issue with that, is that i frequently wake up every night, and when i say "not quite" to the sleep tracker, i can not input my own awake time. If i make any adjustments to it, it assumes i slept through the night. I would really like to see an option in there to add awake time if the leaf does not correctly track my sleep.
I am also disappointed that the leaf appears to no longer have the option to add an activity. I go horseback riding every weekend and now it just gets counted as steps which don't burn as much calories. The horseback riding option leaf originally had was actually very accurate as far as calories burned for the type of riding I do.

The Leaf jewelry is beautiful. I totally get that. I rented this to compare with other trackers. This concept targets young women who are still actively menstruating and does not have an option to turn off the tracking line for those in menopause. So we get our faces rubbed in it when we open the app. As the app says when step data or sleep data was not received, "this is awkward". Ummmm yes, yes it is.

I had to wear extra strong reading glasses to read the app, because print is too tiny for us older gals with weaker eyes, and the contrast between white letters and very soft delicate feminine colors does not enhance visual acuity. I have no doubt that I would have totally loved this as a young teen 40 years ago. But this is not the app and product you are looking for, if you are in your crowning glory years.

In my case I was also looking for heartbeat or heart rate monitor and tracking, and there is no pretense of that here. But even for steps taking on walking, the numbers did not compare well to the wrist trackers I was also tracking. So that is disappointing. The Tracker seemed to gloss over it in terms of "oh, you met your goal of 20 minutes of activity", but no way to tell if it was just shuffling around the house activity or if it was walking at a rate to drive heart rate to 70% of capacity. 

Part of the reason for that is the bracelet is not designed well enough to be flexible in accommodating wrists of all sizes, from thin teenagers to more "Reubenesque" women of size. As a result, wearing as a necklace does not yield as accurate tracking as a wrist based trackers (which are, admittedly ugly and have a harsh rubbery texture against skin.).

So maybe in a few years the systems will be improved to accommodate a wider variety of women and body types and abilities. Let's hope!

And to top it off its accuracy in measuring your breath even clipped to your pants as it suggests is anything but accurate. This product will have to be returned. The kinks are far from resolved. Very disappointing.

title: Wish I could have viewed app before buying a Leaf
review_text: I bought a Leaf hoping to replace my fit bit with a prettier tracker. Unfortunately the leaf up interface doesn't allow me to track my food, water or weight. Big time bummer. Looks like I invested in an expensive broach. Very unfortunate.

title: Could be great but isn't there yet.
review_text: Wish they would use the app for its potential, but development has only gotten worse with each new version. Please bring back the step goal instead of active minutes goal!

title: Terrible
review_text: Goals are now measured based on active time. This update did not think of its users. There should be an options to choose what your goal is based on. I wanted a different option than a fit bit but I am now thinking of caving and getting one. The new updates don't meet my needs and my sleep is not well tracked I believe there  is still a lot of room for improvements.

title: Step count???
review_text: What happened to goals based on step count?? You need to give an option. Do you just randomly have an idea and run with it without thinking of the impact?? I walked 3 miles today but didn't meet your idea of "activity" so I am at 0%. Plus your sleep needs some updating.

title: Where's my steps tracker?!
review_text: Hate the new update. I understand in theory how it would be nice to add activities but why take away the step tracker?! Why not add more functions overall instead of subtracting?

title: Please take this 'update' back
review_text:
When goals changed from steps to active minutes, you turned this activity tracker into a very expensive, but pretty, exercise log. With the latest update I can at least access activities without a crash but if you don't let me go back to using this as an activity tracker -i.e. Steps or distance as a goal vs some arbitrary 'active minutes' - I'll be requesting a refund for the whole thing and dust off my old Fitbit. 

Very disappointed.

title: Loading/sync issues
review_text: The app needs a lot of improvement.  When it does work it's just okay.  I've been trying to open the app for 2 days and it won't open.  The days prior to that it would take multiple tries to sync.  If I delete the app I'll lose my data... Needs work.

title: Meh.
review_text:
This is the first fitness tracker I've owned. 
I thought it would do more in terms of biometrics. 

Step counter/motion seems to work best when Leaf is a broach.  As a necklace, it doesn't count any of my activity. 

I like that it tells me when I've been sedentary for too long, but it doesn't always seem to count certain movements. 

The app itself has about the same amount of "wow factor," that is, not much. 

So far in the app's development, it is self-contained. I'd like to be able to integrate it with the iPhone's built-in Health tracker app. I have a few other fitness apps that I use as well; this would provide a more comprehensive overview of my activity level. 

I would like the app to make the Leaf buzz as acknowledgement when it's done syncing.

title: Upgrade Fail
review_text: I know the intention was to better the software but it really stinks! It's not motivational or encouraging to have walked 4 miles but yet have 0 activity recorded! I wish it would revert back to the previous version!!

title: Changes
review_text: I do not care for the change to the goals section. There had been a goal set by amount of steps, the change to the amount of active time is not preferable

title: Nothing
review_text: After the November update, the app registers nothing when I sync. I know it's working as the alarm works. They took away the steps per day goal and distance walked and gave us an activity goal that maxes out at an hour and ten minutes which is not motivational or useful for me.

title: Some Updates not working
review_text: I love some of the updates - the sleep is recording more accurately and I really appreciate that it is starting to consider more than walking. But the "add activity" section isn't working - it won't let me select an or add an activity. Hope this gets corrected soon!

title: When Adding Activity No Activity Appears
review_text: I was so happy when I saw that now we can add activity. But when I go to add the activity there is nothing there. No activities are listed... At least it doesn't crash like it did before but now it doesn't have any activities to choose from. Fix please!!! (Using on iPhone 6, OS 9.1)

title: Sooooo close...
review_text:
Well, they finally added the ability to add specific activities that has been advertised for awhile (give your developers a break, guys, and don't promise stuff before it's ready for prime time). As usual, though, with this app it's just not ready. There are so many bugs. 

Also, New fitness goals are confusing... What if I want a step goal rather than an active time goal? (I mean, what is active time anyway??) We should be able to choose one or the other. 

Biggest baddest bug: activities almost work but your pull down of activities is not populated with anything yet.

title: Better but not awesome...
review_text: Still unable to add custom activities. Nothing loads after clicking to add an activity.

title: New add activity not working
review_text: The new update includes adding your own activity but whenever I click on the field to add which "Activity", the app crashes and returns to my phone's home screen. I've been waiting for this update since I do so many activities that don't register on the leaf. But it seems I still can't use it. :(

title: Update doesn't help
review_text: I've owned the leaf for 2 months. The app has had many updates and is still a fail. Think you can add activities now? Nice try, the app just closes.

title: Like previous version better
review_text: Just got the new update for the app and already don't like it as much as the first. Now it only tracks your progress for active time. Before if you had a step goal you set your self to meet each day it would show your progress through out the day. Now I have to be active for a set amount of mins. Please give the option in the next update to set it so you can choose if you want and activity goal or step goal!!!!

title: New update
review_text: I love the idea! But the app keeps crashing when I try to add a new activity card. Hopefully this gets fixed soon!

title: Beautiful, sort of Useful
review_text:
The leaf is beautiful and fits with my style so I wear it all the time.

While the app works alright, I do think there could be many improvements.

There are only 3 things it tracks: sleep, steps, and it does breathing exercises.

It usually gets my sleep wrong, thinking I woke up for good when I actually just got up to use the bathroom.

One day it didn't track anything for about 10 hours. I didn't manually update it, but when I did late in the day it had only tracked the last hour or so.

It would be nice if I could input things or notes, similar to the PTracker app. It'd be nice to mark off my moods and any monthly symptoms, and medications I've taken. It would also be nice if it could like into other apps like the Apple Health app.

I'll still keep wearing it as long as it's still tracking my steps, but not sure if I would buy it again. It's so pretty and has so much potential! I wish it worked a little better.

A design teacher once told me, "If it's beautiful you'll make it useful. If it's useful, you'll make it beautiful."

title: New "update" ruined it
review_text: I enjoyed the simplicity of the tracker and the app before the latest update. It will not open anymore. It crashes immediately after the load screen. So I can't use my leaf until they fix it? Seems like a waste of $99!

title: Terrible support - inaccurate tracker
review_text: I have emailed support three times and have not gotten a response to my question. The leaf does not track any steps unless you go 50 steps at one time. You are missing out on the tracking of hundreds of steps a day. What is the point if an activity tracker if it is not accurate? Also when I ordered it was a promo that included a bracelet and the necklace. The bracelet was not included. It is a beautiful device and I will likely return for a refund since support does not care to address my concern. If you want pretty, buy a piece of jewelry. If you want accurate, but a Fit Bit because the Leaf falls terribly short.

title: Poor delivery options
review_text: I just got my shipping e-mail from them.  They sent it USPS delivery confirmation.  Unfortunately, I live in a rural area where they won't deliver confirmation items.  You can't request delivery either.  Instead, I have to drive 25 minutes each way to the post office, during work hours.  If I had known that I had to take off from work to get this, I'd have never bought it.  There are similar items that are much much easier to get.  I hate this already, and I don't even have it (if I can find time during our busy season to even get the thing)

title: Great Device - App is behind the times
review_text:
The Leaf is a light, stylish and functional device but the app is missing many features.  For example:
- No data integration with other fitness apps 
- No graphical trends over prolonged periods of time

Hopefully the next version will be better!

title: So pretty but...
review_text: There is definitely room for improvement with the app. I've been told repeatedly when I write to Bellabeat that they were going to update the app in October 2015 to add the ability to enter activities manually a'la MyFitnessPal, Runkeeper, etc...still waiting. I'm really tired of it coaching me to get some exercise on days when I've done a 90min vinyasa yoga class!!

title: Worthless piece of jewelry and terrible app
review_text: Please go buy a fitness tracker that actually supports its customers and provides a warranty. These flimsy and bulky devices fall off like its a full time job, not to mention the customer service's inability to do anything other than copy and paste generic responses. 0/10 I won't order anything advertised like this crap again.

title: Dawn
review_text: Sleep tracking almost non existent. When it does work , it's completely inaccurate. Now, it will not sync . Emails to bellabeat not answered. I really wanted to love this. =(

title: Nothing but problems!
review_text: Sleep tracking was not accurate. Now no data for past 3 days. Second time there has been no data at all for long period of time. Was working fine before all of these recent updates. I've only had my leaf for a little over a month. More of a pain at this point. Issues need to be fixed!

title: Updates made it horrible!
review_text: I got my leaf a few weeks before the latest update. I was excited because the email said the update would add activities & other options we didn't have. Not the case. My leaf has been running horrible ever since. Stopped tracking my awake times at night. Isn't counting all my steps. My breathing isn't saving. If you ask me the updates have the Leaf more glitches!!! Everyone I've talked to is having the same issues! And no one can get ahold of anyone at Bellabeat! Please fix ASAP!

title: Not quite right
review_text: Either the device itself is doing a poor job of measuring activity, or the app is doing a terrible job of processing the data. I think both. The clip is the recommended placement, but I've been wearing mine that way for a few days and it really only tracks my sleep. I got an alert to say that I've barely moved in five days-- I've definitely been moving. I was cleaning house and got the vibration alert that I had been inactive for 2 straight hours, WHILE I was cleaning! My LEAF wasn't the best at tracking my activity before, but the update has made this even worse. Two stars for tracking my sleep.

title: Good start, but needs work
review_text:
Love the Leaf and the idea behind it. I know a Fitbit or other tech would make me obsessive where it is not needed. 

However, the activity tracker isn't accurate. I ran a competitive race recently and the Leaf shorted me more than a mile (in a 13.1mi race). 

Neither is the sleep monitor. Example, I find it odd that the tracker cannot register when I have to get up in the middle of the night with the baby - still registers me as asleep. 

Last note, since most recent update the Leaf will vibrate but when I sync with the app there is no notification. It is very annoying to be notified for no reason. 

That being said, it has helped me gently shift my habits to be healthier. 

Thanks for this novel, beautiful piece of tech!  I look forward to see how it evolves.

title: Love it
review_text: I am not in very good health and am bed ridden most of the time. This is a great way to remind myself to get up and move as much as I can. Having a goal to work towards each day helps too. And people now believe me when I say I never sleep more than 3 hours a night!

title: Not tracking my steps
review_text:
I've taken 2400 steps
Today according to my iPhone. But my bellabeat app says I haven't even gotten out of bed. It did track my sleep. But I'm not sure why my steps are not being recorded.

title: Need some improvements
review_text:
My App has been having trouble syncing with my Leaf since the last update. Please fix this. 

Also, please include a way to manually add activity. I swim a few times a week and can't add that into my activity tracking. 

I did like the added feature of being able to select where you wear your activity monitor. I do sometimes wear it different ways on different days and nights. Can the app be updated to that you can pick how you wore the tracker that day and that night?

title: Disappointed
review_text: It sounded great in theory, but it doesn't track breathing unless you download the track which I can't get it to download. The steps are pretty accurate, but not the sleep cycle. It is not waterproof either.

title: Confused
review_text:
I love the lead but the app would be better if it allowed you to set vibrations. Sometimes I don't know why the thing is buzzing at me. Maybe an option of 4 buzzes for alarms, 3 for inactivity, 2 for reminder, etc, and an option to track your food/water intake would be great. 

I like the sleep monitor and its precision, and the activity log shows me which parts of my day I tend to be under active. Being aware is half the battle for me sometimes.

title: Oops
review_text:
The update to the sleep tracking looks nice and I'm excited to see how much more accurate it gets knowing where I'm wearing it but the app crashes every time I try to select a location.
Everything else looks good though.

title: Update not well tested before deployed
review_text: When you update how you wear it when you sleep, the app crashed, every time. Other than that, it works better.

title: Pretty, but flawed
review_text: Love the appearance of my leaf but that is about all, unfortunately. I've had it about 3 weeks now and feel mostly disappointed. Sleep tracking is poor; I have to manually edit time every night. Also, even on nights where I've woken and gotten up, it tracks me as asleep the whole night. And nights I sleep fitfully, it reports 98% quality sleep... Not really sure what it's tracking as quality sleep. Fitness wise, I've had two days now where it's told me I've taken zero steps; this is very much not the case! Haven't used the breathing beyond the first training, which I found way too rapidly paced. I was under the impression--like many others as I've read--that it would monitor my breathing pattern and suggest breathing exercises if it detected stress/shallow breathing. I'm very underwhelmed by the period tracker as well; way too basic to be helpful. And you can't track any symptoms that might be cycle related. I just signed up to take surveys after each update, but I haven't experienced an update yet (I was under the impression they update weekly...?). Overall, disappointed with all but how it looks for the price paid.

title: My health is under control
review_text: I always wanted an app like this to monitor my health in all possible aspects. I think LEAF is the one for me. My health data is accurately tracked and neatly presented so I can exactly know what's going on

title: Fun!
review_text: I'm a couple months in now. I like the wake up alarm. Accuracy should be improved. Step count is fairly accurate when worn as a bracelet, decent as a clip at the waist, not so good as a clip on a top, and pretty bad as a necklace. I'd really like to see the addition of a social feature so people can "compete" with friends over step counts. Best would be to interface with other apps, like MFP. FWIW, the sleep tracking is accurate for me since I wear it as a clip on my pajama pants at the waist.

title: Perfect for me
review_text: This app is so convenient. Mainly because I can get rid of my phone. I can sync the device once a week and it keeps all my data. It's perfect for me. Am also really happy with the in-app period calendar

title: Getting seriously annoyed
review_text: Ever since the last update I haven't been able to log in to my account. I had set it up through Facebook login, and now it just loops back to the email login every time I click the Facebook link. Haven't been able sinc my leaf in weeks... FIX THIS NOW. Other than that it's a fairly decent fitness tracker and I'm looking forward to further improvements. Doesn't seem to recognize yoga as exercise..

title: User manual?
review_text:
So far I'm impressed with the app and what it CAN do but I don't understand any of it. It took me two days before I realized I had to manually sync it (and figuring out how was an accident) in order to track my sleep and not just the hours I slept. However, I can't find anywhere how to interpret the graph of how I slept. The breathing exercises are vague and I don't understand how to improve my accuracy (and oh my goodness, that bell is so annoying!!). I can't find ANYWHERE how to use the app. 
Ps, the period tracker is kind of a lame feature. There are so many other apps out there that do the same thing. I guess I don't know what I expected, but so far I'm just using this thing as a motivation to walk everywhere. It's super cute to wear though!

title: Efficient and beautiful!
review_text: I really love this product! I’ve been looking for a health tracker that’s efficient AND beautiful and this one is both. I’ve been tracking my sleep and activity and so far, so good :).

title: A little upset
review_text: The app and leaf was working and tracking really well for me until the last update. Now it doesn't hardly track my steps at all. I hope the next update fixes this problem.

title: It's pretty but has area for improvement in function
review_text:
First off, I LOVE the way my leaf looks! I get a ton of compliments and love it just for that reason. But it could be more functional. I wish you could manually add activities. It needs a place to track water intake, weight, measurements, moods/symptoms/notes for each day, and some type of GPS tracking. 

I had high hopes for the breathing exercises. And while I enjoy them, the accuracy percentage is not well explained. In fact, nothing is explained very well in this app. So a FAQ/tutorial would be helpful. Also breathing exercises that help to promote sleep would be awesome. 

I will continue to wear my leaf because it's pretty and I hope that future updates will increase its function in my life.

title: has potential but riddled with issues
review_text:
Pros:
- can set up alarms to remind you during the day
- aesthetically pleasing

Cons:
- alarms are not very effective when you’re sleeping because they’re too weak
- sleep tracker is grossly inaccurate
- don’t like the breathing exercises
—

I’ve had the leaf for about 1 and 1/2 weeks, and I’ve found it to be a WIP than a final product.
Still debating whether or not I will return it in the next couple weeks. Depends on how customer support will respond to my email.

title: Intuitive and simple, love it
review_text: My favorite health monitoring application. Intuitive interface, easy to use, just keeping it simple and it has a great period calendar. The new app update for iOS should enable us to enter specific activities so it can be more accurate

title: The breathing exercises rock!
review_text: I generally like how this app is designed, simple but beautiful. But the breathing exercises… just great. I didn’t expect to have such a positive impact on my sleep. I do an exercise almost every night before sleep since I got it. Warmly recommend it. zzzzzzzzzzz :)

title: Clean, simple!
review_text: Sleep tracking is awesome, activity tracking is just as good as fitbit’s. Breathing exercises are definitely a pro for me. Clean, simple, and a great way to start the day. Recommended - but you’ll have to buy the device first.

title: Needs Some Improvements/Guidance
review_text:
I have two main issues with the Leaf. First I think it is a huge flaw to not be able to add activity, at all. It would be ideal to add from other trackers or fitness trackers or gps watch companies online trackers or apps like runkeeper; or to add water activities since it is not water resistant/proof. While it is possible to add sleep manually it would be better to simply be able to put the leaf into sleep mode, for afternoon naps or the person who has a night shift.

The second request/recommendation is the app and the device both need to come with more guidance and suggestions. Instructions on how to best wear the leaf to track sleep, or breathing or recommendation on syncing procedures to save battery life which I only read on the app's development section. The stress reduction breathing could also work better as it doesn't really give feedback. Also if you could alert the app to how and where you wear the leaf would be helpful perhaps also for the app designer.

I have really high hopes the developers will address these issues because other than those things, I love the look of the leaf. Super gorgeous.

title: App isn't good.
review_text: I really like the LEAF itself but the app isn't very good at all :-/ especially after using the FitBit app for over a year. Specifically what is frustrating for me is that the breathing exercises don't work on the app. I sync my Leaf and press play and nothing happens. The scrubber says 00:00 out of 00:00. Just frustrating that a huge component of the marketed features doesn't even work.

title: Not impressed
review_text: I'm not sure if it's the app or the actual product itself but I feel like I spent way too much money on something that barely works like advertised. Pretty much all it does is poorly track steps. The sleep portion doesn't really work..you have to enter in the time you were asleep. A couple times I've done it and it says I was apparently in deep sleep the whole time.. The way the breathing portion is advertised makes you think it always tracks breathing..my thought was it tracked your breathing and would alert you if it felt you were anxious or whatever and then have you do a breathing exercise to calm down. Nope they only have breathing exercises that give you an accuracy rating that isn't explained. Right now I feel like I wasted my money..hopefully some updates will improve this product. Right now it's just a pretty piece of jewelry.

title: Loved it but....
review_text: It was great in the beginning but now after not even a week it's not tracking all my steps or sleep. Really disappointed in the app and product

title: Pretty app, limited functionality
review_text: Excited to start using Leaf for lifestyle tracking and am excited for the October update that's supposed to allow adding in activity. Until, it would be great if they could sync with other apps like myfitness pal for calorie tracking or argus for activity tracking with gps capability

title: Hoping they make improvements
review_text: This is a nice concept. The sensor is not accurate though. Like the other reviewer, it does not register my sleep on time. The step counter also seems to be an underestimation. The calorie counter is misleading- does not increase with workout. It would be nice if there was somewhere to input these things into the app.

title: Love it BUT...
review_text: This app is still in its infancy stage. It is just a simple sleep tracker, menstrual cycle tracker and step tracker. I would like to see a gps attached to the app. So you can track your areas you walked and what activity you did during those steps, like aerobics, weights, run or walk etc.  I would like to see a weight tracker so you can track if you gained or lost weight. For the sleep tracker I would like to tell me if I was restless or just normal sleep movements. For the period tracker I would like it to also be able log your symptoms and moods. Not just when you start and when you stop. This will help you to communicate your irregularities to your doctor if there are any.

title: Want to love it
review_text:
Pros
So pretty and Versatile 

App is straightforward 

Cycle tracking is interesting 

Cons
Sleep tracking is not accurate for me. I do wear it as a bracelet.  Gets me as asleep 1 hour later than I really do.  Wake up is ok.  But once you edit the times the graph redraws looking totally different 

Step count is not accurate since 9/22/15 update (way low)

Buggy when syncing: not consistent with timeframe downloaded. Doesn't like downloading often. Sometimes it says it syncs but nothing changes

title: Love/Hate
review_text: I love tracking my steps & sleep, and the look, I get so many compliments everyday. BUT, I hate that it won't stay on. It refuses to stay on the necklace, the bracelet doesn't fit, and when I wear it on my pants, I forget and it falls in the toilet the second I pull my pants down. I'm over it. NEED a way to keep it on!

title: Such a bad app
review_text: I really enjoy my leaf and I wanted to use the breathing exercises but they refused to download and after a half hour of watching it stay at 0% I tried just about everything to get it to work. I finally deleted the app and redownloaded it to see if that would help.  And now it won't even open or do anything rendering my leaf useless. Awesome.

title: Love the LEAF and the app!
review_text: I have been looking for a quality activity plus tracker (plus meaning it does more than count my steps). I had backed Olive but they cancelled their production. Then I found LEAF. Firstly, I love the look of the wearable itself, stainless and wood, very jewelry-esque. The app is great too! Easy to use, nice looking UI, I even like the colors they chose. I also love the fact that the company is run by women for women. I would recommend the LEAF and app to any woman! **Note-you need the LEAF wearable to use the app!

title: Great design and personalized tracking
review_text: This is the activity tracking app I've always wanted but never found....until now. I love how it just works without much effort on my part. It helps me track my daily activities, distance travelled and my sleep routine has improved significantly. Keeping track of my monthly cycle and doing the recommended exercises have improved my reproductive health as well. Highly recommended.
